states: Paired production previews in Playwright 1.56.1, light desktop Chromium 141 and dark touch WebKit 26. Fixture responses come from the exact base monitor runtime; separately checked the API status handler.

Fresh success is green; six background HTTP 200 reads return identical status bytes and a success ping at the recommended grace now reads No recent heartbeat in amber (not a status read failure or a diagnosed stall).
Current server-reported stall stays red with the explanation. A newly accepted success restores green and the original ages and restart detail remain.
Retained desktop and narrow captures were inspected. Masking, Remove, Refresh, monitor progress, failure count, and last interruption stay visible; no horizontal overflow in the watchdog panel.
interactions: Advance the existing browser timers by 30 seconds per background status read, using the same app panel, browser clock and producer replies before and after.

Use Enter on desktop or tap on phone to Refresh after a current monitoring stall. A later background read of actual recovered fixture data updates the same panel. The browser does not send a heartbeat or modify settings.
